extraction_notes: The datasheet is a family sheet (DSK12 THRU DSK120, Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd, SOD-123FL). DSK14 takes the DSK12-DSK14 grouped column for maximum forward voltage (0.55 V at IF = 1.0 A), the DSK12-DSK16 grouped column for maximum DC reverse current (0.2 mA at 25 degC, 20 mA at 100 degC), the DSK12-DSK14 grouped column for typical junction capacitance (110 pF), the solid DSK12-DSK14 curve in Fig. 3, and the solid DSK12-DSK16 curves in Fig. 4. Column spans were confirmed visually against the table cell borders on a 200 dpi render and match the Fig. 3/Fig. 4 legend groupings.

Fig. 3 y-axis labels are misprinted: '10' sits exactly on the first decade gridline below the top, but '1' is printed mid-decade (551 px below the top at 400 dpi, between the decade lines at 427 px and 678 px) and '0.1' is printed at the bottom frame. Pixel measurement of the 400 dpi render shows decade gridlines at 175/426.5/677.5/928 px below the top frame (250.9 px per decade) with the 40/30/20 minor lines fitting a top-frame value of 50 A, so the axis actually spans 50 A at the top to 0.01 A at the bottom; the digitization is anchored on the unambiguous 50 and 10 labels and the minor-gridline geometry.

Curves were digitized programmatically from a 400 dpi render: Fig. 3 x-axis calibrated on labeled gridlines (0 V to 1.6 V linear, 130.9 px per 0.2 V) and the corrected log y-axis above; Fig. 4 calibrated on its consistent axes (x: 0% to 100% linear, 209 px per 20%; y: 100 mA to 0.001 mA over five 185.0 px decades). Gridlines (1-3 px) were separated from curve strokes (5-6 px) by run thickness, the solid DSK12-DSK14 curve was read as the leftmost stroke on each scanline in Fig. 3, and the two solid DSK12-DSK16 curves in Fig. 4 were followed by column-wise continuity tracing. All sampled points were verified visually against a marker overlay on the render. Fig. 4 y-values are converted from mA to A.

Consistency checks: digitized typical VF at 1.0 A is 0.42 V, below the 0.55 V table maximum; digitized 25 degC reverse current at 98% of rated VR is 1.9e-5 A, below the 2.0e-4 A table maximum; digitized 100 degC reverse current at 98% is 6.3e-3 A, below the 2.0e-2 A table maximum at 100 degC.
The reverse-current table also gives IR2 = 20 mA at VR = VDC, TA = 100 degC for DSK12-DSK16; the required reverse_current field records the 25 degC row.

Absolute maximum ratings for DSK14 include VRRM = 40 V, VRMS = 28 V, VDC = 40 V, IF(AV) = 1.0 A at 60 Hz sine wave resistance load, IFSM = 25 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, Tj = -55 to +125 degC (DSK12-DSK16 group), RthJA = 85 degC/W, and RthJL = 20 degC/W. These ratings are not breakdown characterization data. Device marking code is K14.
The supplied PDF identifies Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com); the top-level manufacturer preserves the exact job identity hongjiacheng.

Fig. 1 (forward current derating, DSK12-DSK16 dashed curve applies to DSK14) and Fig. 2 (non-repetitive peak forward surge current) are rating plots, not diode IV or reverse-leakage characteristics, and were not digitized.
omission_reason: The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time and no reverse-breakdown characterization; reverse_recovery, breakdown_voltage, and breakdown_current remain null.
